clips.title: The story
paras: At Razor Hill, Innkeeper Grosk welcomes travelers on the road between the Valley of Trials and Orgrimmar. His inn offers food, drink, and a place to rest in central Durotar.

Razor Hill links Durotar’s southern training grounds with Orgrimmar’s high walls. Innkeeper Grosk shelters warriors, scouts, and peons at his inn. Travelers find basic provisions, hearty meats, and cool water beneath its sturdy timbers.

Grosk also helps the laborers who keep Durotar running. Ukor, a timid peon, hauled food to the Valley of Trials only to learn it was not needed. He asks travelers to carry the load back to Grosk’s inn in Razor Hill.
